title: Census Nonemployer County Industry Context
description: Versioned county, state, and national annual aggregate context for explicitly selected 2022 NAICS industries.
semantics: Annual aggregate counts for businesses with no paid employees; not named businesses or current operating status.
Missing county cells remain explicitly missing and are not imputed.
Flagged source values remain in raw fields; their usable measures are null and excluded from residual sums. True unflagged zero remains zero.
National/state minus county figures sum usable known county cells only and do not measure completeness or missing businesses.
No ZIP or ZCTA allocation; these data do not establish collection completeness.
